pages.title: Conformal Cyclic Cosmology
pages.text: $(thing)Conformal Cyclic Cosmology$()$(br2)At the end of time only massless things remain, and massless things cannot tell an infinite distance from a finite one. Rescale the dead universe and its infinite future becomes the Big Bang of the next aeon.

$(thing)Insight$(): 280$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Creation from Nothing, Heat Death, Cosmogenesis.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 De Sitter Horizon Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Light does not care about the size of space, only about its shape: it moves through conformal time, the integral of c dt divided by the scale factor a(t). In a universe that ends in pure vacuum energy, a(t) = a₀ e^{Ht} grows exponentially forever. Write how much conformal time is left from t₀ to the infinite future.
